## Advanced Plots

Specialised plots grouped by data type: hierarchies, models, forecasts, networks, spatial analysis and dashboards.

---

### ▸ Categorical Plots

Includes:
- Treemaps (hierarchical proportions)
- Sunburst charts (circular hierarchies)
- Dendrograms (clustering)
- Marimekko charts (two-way composition)
- Waffle charts (unit visualization)
🔗 [View Slide Deck →](advanced/3.1_categorical_advanced.qmd)

---

### ▸ Continuous Plots

Includes:
- Contour plots (2D density)
- 3D surface plots
- Parallel coordinates
- Correlation matrix
- Hexbin plots (large data)
🔗 [View Slide Deck →](advanced/3.2_continuous_advanced.qmd)

---

### ▸ Category vs. Continuous

Includes:
- Effect plots (model-based)
- Interaction plots
- Marginal effects
- Forest plots of model coefficients
- Rainclouds for nested groups
- Bayesian credible intervals
🔗 [View Slide Deck →](advanced/3.3_category_vs_continuous_advanced.qmd)

---

### ▸ Time

Includes:
- STL decomposition (trend/seasonal)
- Forecasting with ARIMA
- Prophet models
- Change point detection
- Rolling statistics
🔗 [View Slide Deck →](advanced/3.4_timeseries_advanced.qmd)

### ▸ Network flow

Includes:
- Community detection algorithms
- Centrality measures visualization
- Network statistics
- Bipartite networks
- Networks over time
🔗 [View Slide Deck →](advanced/3.5_network_advanced.qmd)

### ▸ Geographical

Includes:
- Spatial interpolation (IDW)
- Cartograms (area distortion)
- Spatial autocorrelation
- Hexagon tile maps
- Distance bands for access
🔗 [View Slide Deck →](advanced/3.6_geographic_advanced.qmd)

### ▸ Dashboard

Includes:
- Dashboard layout principles
- Shiny app structure
- Reactive programming
- plotly interactivity
- flexdashboard framework
🔗 [View Slide Deck →](advanced/3.7_dashboards_advanced.qmd)

## Self-check quiz

```{r}
#| include: false
source("../assets/quiz.R")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
quiz_mcq("pa1", "36 months of dengue counts should be split into trend, season and noise. Which method does that?",
         c("A cartogram", "STL decomposition", "Parallel coordinates", "Community detection"), answer = 2,
         explain = "STL (seasonal-trend decomposition by loess) separates a series into trend, seasonal and remainder components.")
quiz_mcq("pa2", "Which plot makes a regression's coefficients easy to compare with zero?",
         c("A 3D density surface", "A hexagon tile map", "A forest (coefficient) plot", "A Sankey diagram of the model terms"), answer = 3,
         explain = "A forest plot shows each estimate with its confidence interval next to a reference line at 0.")
quiz_mcq("pa3", "A cartogram resizes each block by its population. What does it show better than a normal map?",
         c("The exact borders of each block", "Where the people are, not the land", "The road distance to each of the clinics", "The shape of each block's outline"), answer = 2,
         explain = "Areas proportional to population show where the people (and so most cases) are; large empty blocks no longer dominate.")
```
